description: She wears an ivory floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow sleeves, edged in rich burgundy-gold woven geometric borders. Jewelled round shoulder brooches and a decorated waist belt with hanging ornaments fasten the garment. A burgundy embroidered wrap rests along her forearms; cream lower trousers show through a modest lower walking opening above gold-brown shoes. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
